investigation_questions.question: Is there an existing Jeeb microservice that can handle this case?
Is there another Olivium microservice that can handle the situation?
Can an existing microservice be adjusted while keeping the feature Jeeb-domain-independent, Jeeb-agnostic and reusable?
As a last resort, is a new repository required?

architecture_rules: The gateway is a stateless BFF with no Postgres connection or durable state.
UPG is not used by Jeeb.
Extensions must be additive and backward-compatible unless separately approved.
All wallet value changes are performed through wallet transactions.
No new repository is currently required.

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Yes. wallet-service already provides wallet holders, multiple wallets and transaction legs.
investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No. UPG is excluded and payment-gateway/OliviumPay have the wrong boundary.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: No COD-specific extension is required. Use the existing generic wallet and transaction contracts.

points.review_comment: No, you can create 2 wallets per jeeber, you don't need to do any modification

final_answer.plan: Delete gateway settlement persistence. Create one wallet holder per Jeeber with the two configured wallets following Creamati, and record COD earnings and fees as wallet transaction legs.

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Yes. wallet-service transaction headers and statuses are the closest existing representation.
investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No suitable non-UPG service exists.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Add generic transaction search/filtering and a durable external reference only if required for stable batch lookup.

final_answer.plan: Delete gateway settlement_batches. Represent a batch with a wallet transaction header and its detail legs; pending means open, executed means paid and aborted means cancelled. CMS queries by generic service, tag, date and status.

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Yes. wallet-service transactions are the financial write boundary.
investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No additional service is needed.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Add a generic durable Idempotency-Key and request fingerprint to transaction initiation because the current API creates a new transaction ID on every call.

points.review_comment: No, all wallet changes must be done through transactions only, you can check the cremat implementation

final_answer.plan: Reject and delete settlement_enqueue. Retry the same idempotent wallet transaction instead of persisting an enqueue marker.
constraints: Every wallet value change is a transaction
Do not move the marker to state-service

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Yes. wallet-service TransactionHeader and TransactionDetails are the canonical ledger.
investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No. OliviumPay supplies patterns only and cannot own Jeeb finance truth.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Make generic multi-leg execution atomic and expose projections over executed transactions.

final_answer.plan: Delete gateway settlement_ledger_entries and its reconciler. Transaction headers and details become the only ledger; earnings are projections over executed transactions.

investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No. order-service represents ecommerce baskets, not delivery execution.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Add only neutral requester, assignee, metadata and external-reference fields and filters.

points.review_comment: Okay, but no jeeb specific domoain must be added to the delivery microservice

investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: None by default; compose existing APIs.

investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: No reusable audit owner is closer.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Add generic immutable events keyed by application, actor, action and opaque resource reference.

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Yes. jeeb-state-service plus existing domain APIs can own durable workflow state and deletion actions.
investigation_answers.q2_other_olivium_service: Yes. background-worker supplies scheduling and retry.
investigation_answers.q3_reusable_extension: Add generic due-work leasing/CAS and production-safe scheduled execution.

final_answer.plan: Store an opaque deletion workflow in state-service; background-worker invokes idempotent domain-owner actions through the stateless gateway orchestrator.
constraints: Harden worker leasing and high availability

investigation_answers.q1_existing_jeeb_service: Partly. jeeb-state-service can own generic job metadata while each domain exposes subject-scoped export fragments.

investigation_answers.q4_new_repository: Only if no approved organization-wide private blob platform exists; never create a Jeeb-specific export repository.

final_answer.plan: Persist generic background-compatible delivery exceptions, expose list/update APIs, migrate open records and remove the gateway queue.

constraints: Non-zero system funding must be a transaction
